desc:
🦴 RAGDOLL UNIVERSE: see every bone break.

Hit a dummy and watch its skeleton flash through in X-RAY. Every shot lands where you aim and the body reacts to it.

🎯 REAL HIT REACTIONS
• Headshots drop them instantly
• Shoot a leg and they limp, stumble and fall
• Arrows go clean through the body
• Fire chars them black

🔫 60+ WEAPONS
• Pistols, snipers, miniguns, bows, chainsaws, flamethrowers
• Gravity gun, black hole grenade, orbital laser, nuke and more

🏭 DEADLY MACHINES
• Strap dummies into the crash test sled
• Feed them to the sawmill
• Crush them with the junkyard crane and baler

🧟 ZOMBIE NIGHT
• Survive the horde, win rewards 

🤝 LIVING DUMMIES
• Dummies drag their wounded friends to safety
• Sandbox mode: spawn dummies and set up your own experiments

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to get notified when new weapons drop!
